# Sanking Cat Litter (Malaysia)

> Sanking is a cat litter brand sold in Malaysia and distributed by MDL Distribution Sdn Bhd (Shah Alam, Selangor). It sells two lines: Sanking Classic (Carbon Fine Bentonite, 7L/10L/20L) and Sanking Natura (plant-based tofu litter - Original, Lavender, Green Tea). Products are sold on Shopee Malaysia and Lazada Malaysia.

## Brand facts
- Brand: Sanking
- Distributor / company: MDL Distribution Sdn Bhd
- Address: 35/135, Alam Impian 13, Jalan Raja Bot, Section 35, 40460 Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia
- Contact: +6010-932 0118 / enquiry@mdl.com.my / https://mdl.com.my
- Markets served: Malaysia (primary), Singapore, Indonesia, Brunei
- Aggregate marketplace rating: 4.8 / 5 (aggregated from Shopee Malaysia + Lazada Malaysia listings)

## Product lines
- Sanking Classic Carbon Fine Bentonite - activated-carbon bentonite, ~3-second clumping, 99% dust-free, strong odour control. Sizes: 7L (~RM16.90), 10L (~RM24.90), 20L (~RM39.90).
- Sanking Natura Tofu Cat Litter - plant-based (pea fibre + soy residue + charcoal), 99% dust-free, flushable, biodegradable, fast clumping, ~4 weeks per tray. Scents: Original, Lavender, Green Tea. 7L from ~RM16.90; 21L bundle up to ~RM45.90.
